authorization: User requested actual stronger project results and overnight queues on 2026-10-06.
question: Does deploying the immutable baseline with 10-action replanning improve settled folds over its shipped 50-action execution queue?

intervention.policy_inputs: three rasterized RGB views and twelve observed robot joints

historical_rationale: v9 baseline descriptively settled H10 16/48 versus H50 9/48; this is a new runtime intervention comparison, not a checkpoint improvement claim.
task_prompt: fold the garment on the table

seeds.rule: 98000 + 100*replicate + development pose; smoke=97900; same seed for both runtime horizons

gpu.design: Both arms of each pair execute consecutively on the same allocated GPU. Order is counterbalanced by pose and replicate.

protocol.primary_metric: terminal_success after 600 policy actions plus 60 fixed hold-settle physics steps
protocol.primary_test: one-sided exact paired McNemar across 48 matched pairs
protocol.improvement_rule: all 48 pairs valid AND candidate wins at least 5 additional settled folds AND one-sided paired p <= 0.05
protocol.secondary: reached versus settled, per-pose counts, control latency and policy plan counts; descriptive only
protocol.promotion: A development screen cannot establish held-out generalization. No automatic checkpoint replacement or final-set execution.
protocol.invalid_policy: Infrastructure failures are missing data, not failed folds; no outcome-driven retries.
protocol.stop_rule: One full-episode smoke pair, then exactly 48 development pairs; no extra seeds, no retries, no checkpoint search.
protocol.scope: Pant_Short on the eight reused development poses; rasterized simulator results only; no hardware deployment claim.

outputs: JSON, JSONL, logs, PNG, MP4 only; prohibit creating new .md and .txt files.
